posts.title: Never Go at It Alone: Overcoming Self-Limiting Beliefs
posts.description: I'm challenging two of my firmest and long-held limiting beliefs: 1. since I failed at learning Japanese, I'll never be able to learn Spanish; 2. due to my genetics, I'll never be very healthy. I used to accept these beliefs as facts, which has held me back from doing something about them even though I have evidence that I am actually capable of changing these "inevitable" outcomes.
